title: OutputNotAFileName payload
description: A `command` step whose `output:` is blank, holds a path separator, starts with `.`, or is a name the run directory already uses for its own records (map.rs `CommandStep::RESERVED_OUTPUTS`). The refusal's code is `empty_declaration` for a blank one and `unsupported_construct` otherwise, at `<step>.output` (map.rs `validated_output`).
